v0.1.2.description:
### New Features
- The list of custom keybinds for QoL changes (F8 for Level Selection menu, F11 for mobile Storage Box access) is now listed underneath the Archipelago server entry field
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed multiple issues where key items would disappear after being picked up if they were placed into a puzzle such as the Plate items, Ring items, etc.
- Fixed a visual bug that resulted in two Elsters being shown if the player loaded into the Penrose Wreck using the Level Selection menu
- Fixed a logic issue that resulted in unbeatable seeds
- Fixed an issue where one-sided doors would have to be re-unlocked if the player reloaded a level through the Level Selection menu

### New Features

- Thank you to [pl4gue](https://github.com/pl4gue) for implementing a revamped Archipelago connection menu

### Bug Fixes

- An additional thank you to pl4gue for fixing deathlink
- Several logic fixes

### Known Issues

v0.2.5.description:
### New Features

- Added a YAML option to not randomize the Airlock Key (Broken) and Adhesive Tape items before you reach the first Save Room

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the 'Grenade Shells (Corrupted Installation AEON - Classroom 4B)' location was not randomized
- Removed the '12mm Ammo (Nowhere - Operating Room)' location
- Changed the Item types for the Wooden Dolls from Useful to Progression

### Known Issues

- Goals associated with game endings are currently broken (selecting Artifact ending in the YAML options will still generate the Keys in the item pool, but beating the game by fighting FLKR will incorrectly Goal the slot)
